review.images: Reviewed the official panoramic entry image and all six original Valo gallery assets. Kept six distinct views, omitting the narrower alternate crop of the same entry. The tower plaza is the card image. Two apartment interiors appear separately from the shared lobby.
review.location: Reviewed the developer’s regional map and exact Valo brochure physical page 5, with Valo separately marked on the neighbourhood plan. Official point retained as a reference. Read all four source times visually.
review.floorPlans: Fresh official 29-page PDF matched original cache. Reviewed the cover and every residence drawing and numerical panel. Pages 2–27 are apartments and 28–29 are three-bedroom townhouses showing both levels. Area panels were extracted by physical position, matched visually to level and unit, and checked against the independent text extraction. All printed square-foot component sums agree.
